TinyDataTable.summary: Feature-rich data tables for business interfaces, with search, filters, pagination, grouping and AJAX workflows.
dependencies: Works with HTML tables, arrays or AJAX endpoints.
Fits dashboards, back-offices and admin apps.

strengths.title: Explore complex datasets
strengths.description: Sorting, global search and column filters help users locate relevant records without leaving the table.

strengths.title: Keep context close
strengths.description: Selected rows, grouped data, child rows and aggregates keep detail and summary in the same workspace.

strengths.title: Connect to real data
strengths.description: AJAX loading makes the table suitable for interfaces backed by application APIs.

TinyScheduler.summary: Interactive calendars and scheduling views for teams, bookings and resources, with month, week, day, list and timeline layouts.
dependencies: Works with local events or AJAX-loaded resources.
Fits booking, staffing and planning tools.

strengths.title: Choose the right time scale
strengths.description: Month, week, day and list views provide different levels of planning detail.

strengths.title: Plan by resource
strengths.description: Timeline and resource views bring people, rooms or equipment into the scheduling picture.

strengths.title: Spot scheduling conflicts
strengths.description: Conflict detection and event interactions support clearer planning workflows.

TinyAutocomplete.summary: Smart suggestions for inputs with local or AJAX search, highlighted matches and strong keyboard support.
dependencies: Works with arrays, objects or async endpoints.
Fits search bars, smart forms and command-like inputs.

strengths.title: Reduce search friction
strengths.description: Suggestions and highlighted matches make long choices easier to find.

strengths.title: Local or remote data
strengths.description: Use a local source or connect suggestions to AJAX search.

strengths.title: Keyboard-friendly flow
strengths.description: Keyboard navigation and cancellation of outdated requests keep fast input usable.

TinySelectize.summary: Enhanced selection fields with search, AJAX options, single or multiple modes and an API for value management.
dependencies: Works from native select markup, arrays or remote data.
Fits complex forms and admin tools.

strengths.title: Search instead of scrolling
strengths.description: Searchable options work better than a long conventional select.

strengths.title: Pick one or several
strengths.description: Single and multiple selection modes cover different kinds of forms.

strengths.title: Dynamic option sources
strengths.description: AJAX loading and a value API make selections manageable in richer applications.

TinyChips.summary: Token and tag input management with add/remove flows, structured values and JSON / CSV synchronization.
dependencies: Fits tagging UIs and multi-value forms.

strengths.title: Make multi-value input visible
strengths.description: Each tag becomes an easy-to-read, editable token.

strengths.title: Guide entry
strengths.description: Autocomplete support can help users reuse known values.

strengths.title: Keep values portable
strengths.description: HTML-field synchronization and JSON/CSV formats connect chip input to forms and APIs.

TinyDatePicker.summary: Flexible date selection for single dates or ranges, with inline, modal or permanent display modes.
dependencies: Optional event markers or disabled dates.
Fits booking, analytics and planning workflows.

strengths.title: Select dates or ranges
strengths.description: A single calendar can support precise dates and longer periods.

strengths.title: Fit the surrounding UI
strengths.description: Inline, modal and permanent modes suit different screen layouts.

strengths.title: Offer contextual dates
strengths.description: Event markers, localization and light/dark themes bring useful context to the picker.

tinyColorPicker.summary: A theme-aware color picker with presets, custom colors and CSS variable output for creative interfaces.
dependencies: Outputs values or CSS custom properties.
Fits editors, theme settings and design tools.

strengths.title: Make choices visual
strengths.description: The user can inspect and select colors rather than enter raw color codes.

strengths.title: Adapt to your theme
strengths.description: Custom palettes and light/dark presentation support different applications.

strengths.title: Connect to UI styling
strengths.description: CSS custom properties and embedded usage make selected colors useful elsewhere.

TinySignature.summary: Canvas-based signature capture with smooth Bézier strokes, mouse/touch input and PNG, JPEG or SVG export.
dependencies: Exports raster images, SVG or raw points.
Fits approvals, contracts and onboarding flows.

strengths.title: Capture natural input
strengths.description: Smooth Bézier strokes and mouse/touch support help create readable signatures.

strengths.title: Correct mistakes
strengths.description: Undo and redo let users amend a signature without restarting their entire flow.

strengths.title: Export the result
strengths.description: PNG, JPEG, SVG and point-data formats cover several storage and display needs.

TinyTabs.summary: Tabbed navigation for organizing dense content with active indicators, disabled tabs, swipe support and a selection API.
dependencies: Works with semantic tab / panel markup.
Fits dashboards, settings and mobile content groups.

strengths.title: Organize complex screens
strengths.description: Separate content into focused panels without moving to another page.

strengths.title: Support keyboard and touch
strengths.description: Keyboard navigation and swipeable mode serve different input devices.

strengths.title: Control state from code
strengths.description: A selection API makes tabs usable as part of a larger application workflow.

TinyDropdown.summary: Contextual dropdown menus with automatic positioning, viewport collision handling and keyboard navigation.
dependencies: Uses a trigger plus menu items.
Fits toolbars, cards, forms and table row actions.

strengths.title: Fit compact actions
strengths.description: Contextual menus keep commands available without consuming permanent layout space.

strengths.title: Respect viewport edges
strengths.description: Automatic positioning and collision handling reduce clipped menus.

strengths.title: Support quick selection
strengths.description: Keyboard navigation and typeahead make larger option menus easier to use.

TinySideNav.summary: Side navigation and panel layouts for apps, with left/right placement, touch gestures, fixed modes and optional scroll locking.
dependencies: Uses a nav container plus trigger controls.
Fits dashboards, docs and app shells.

strengths.title: Save screen space
strengths.description: Overlay navigation keeps secondary information available only when needed.

strengths.title: Work on mobile
strengths.description: Animated opening and touch gestures support smaller devices.

strengths.title: Control the backdrop
strengths.description: Fixed modes and optional scroll locking help match app navigation patterns.

TinyCollapsible.summary: Expandable content sections and accordions with configurable animation, keyboard support and open/close callbacks.
dependencies: Fits FAQs, settings groups and docs.

strengths.title: Reveal details progressively
strengths.description: Collapsed panels reduce visual noise when information is secondary.

strengths.title: Build accordion flows
strengths.description: Grouped panels can offer one-section-at-a-time interaction.

strengths.title: Tune the experience
strengths.description: Animation settings, callbacks and keyboard controls support different UX needs.

TinyGroupButton.summary: Grouped button controls for toggles, segmented views and filter bars with single or multiple selection modes.
dependencies: Works from grouped buttons or generated options.
Fits filters, settings and segmented controls.

strengths.title: Group related decisions
strengths.description: Keep related toggles in one compact control.

strengths.title: Handle one or many values
strengths.description: Choice modes and select-all behavior serve filters and configuration screens.

strengths.title: Keep state in sync
strengths.description: Value synchronization and change events connect the group to the rest of the UI.

TinyGallery.summary: Responsive image galleries with uploads, drag-and-drop, reordering, undo and optional TinyLightbox integration.
dependencies: Fits CMS screens, product galleries and media managers.

strengths.title: Manage collections visually
strengths.description: Responsive gallery layouts help users browse groups of media.

strengths.title: Edit the collection
strengths.description: Adding files, dragging to reorder and undoing removals support everyday workflows.

strengths.title: Inspect media in detail
strengths.description: TinyLightbox integration provides a path from thumbnail to focused viewing.

TinyLightbox.summary: A fullscreen media viewer with next/previous navigation, zoom, pan, touch gestures and captions.
dependencies: Works with image lists or TinyGallery collections.
Fits product media, portfolios and screenshot viewers.

strengths.title: Focus on imagery
strengths.description: Fullscreen viewing gives media a dedicated, distraction-free presentation.

strengths.title: Inspect fine detail
strengths.description: Zoom and pan support more than simple next/previous navigation.

strengths.title: Navigate naturally
strengths.description: Touch gestures, keyboard shortcuts and captions work across device types.

TinyCarousel.summary: Configurable carousels for media or content, with 3D effects, indicators, progress bars and responsive layouts.
dependencies: Works with slides of any content type.
Fits marketing sites, onboarding flows and showcases.

strengths.title: Present a sequence clearly
strengths.description: Arrows, indicators and progress feedback help visitors understand slide position.

strengths.title: Tune visual energy
strengths.description: Configurable 3D animations and full-width layouts support different styles.

strengths.title: Adapt to viewport width
strengths.description: Responsive options and multiple visible slides work for different screen sizes.

TinySwal.summary: Polished dialogs, alerts, confirmations and toasts with theming, async validation, timers and draggable windows.
dependencies: Can embed custom form markup or controls.
Fits feedback, confirmation and async save flows.

strengths.title: Upgrade feedback
strengths.description: Alerts, confirmations and toasts share a consistent visual language.

strengths.title: Support richer workflows
strengths.description: Embedded forms and asynchronous validation go beyond basic alert dialogs.

strengths.title: Fit different contexts
strengths.description: Timers, progress indicators, dragging and themes offer flexible presentation.

TinyInlineEditor.summary: Inline editing for text content with rich toolbar controls, HTML formatting and optional autosave.
dependencies: Works on text blocks and editable content areas.
Fits CMS, notes and admin content editing.

strengths.title: Edit without changing context
strengths.description: Users can update displayed content directly where they read it.

strengths.title: Go beyond plain text
strengths.description: Toolbar actions, links, lists, colors and HTML formatting cover richer documents.

strengths.title: Manage several editing areas
strengths.description: Independent editors and optional autosave suit content-management screens.

TinySortableList.summary: Reorderable lists with drag-and-drop, mouse, touch, stylus and keyboard support, even for dynamic content.
dependencies: Works with list items or card stacks.
Fits task ordering, settings and prioritization UIs.

strengths.title: Manipulate ordering directly
strengths.description: Drag-and-drop makes prioritization and ordering easy to understand.

strengths.title: Support multiple input devices
strengths.description: Mouse, touch, stylus and keyboard interactions widen usability.

strengths.title: Handle evolving lists
strengths.description: Items added dynamically can be included in reordering flows.

TinyT.summary: A lightweight JavaScript template engine with expressions, conditions, loops, nested templates and DOM rendering.
dependencies: Fits widgets, dashboards and lightweight apps.

quickstart.js:
const tpl = `
    {{#each users}}
  • {{name}}
    • {{/each}}
`; TinyT.render("#users-view", tpl, { users });

strengths.title: Render dynamic content
strengths.description: Expressions and DOM rendering add data-driven output to lightweight pages.

strengths.title: Keep templates expressive
strengths.description: Conditions, loops and nested templates support repeated UI structures.

strengths.title: Choose your integration
strengths.description: The engine supports utility functions and an optional jQuery integration.
